policies.text: If the country of citizenship of something is X, and the head of state of X is Y, then the head of state of the country of citizenship of that thing is Y.
If the educated at of something is X, and the headquarters location of X is Y, then the headquarters location of the educated at of that thing is Y.
If the manufacturer of something is X, and the headquarters location of X is Y, then the headquarters location of the manufacturer of that thing is Y.

If the country of citizenship of the child of the spouse of something is X, and the head of government of X is Y, then the head of government of the country of citizenship of the child of the spouse of that thing is Y.
